test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word FRANCK (in both forward and backward directions) which have as many letters between them in the word as there are in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

**Given word:** FRANCK

According to the question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e2ce6d6573c5e3a2f90b9ccb76e9e356eaa9696b5c826a9236938cb9db3114f.png] 

There are two pairs in the forward direction: FK, AC

There is no pair in the backward direction.

∴ The total number of pairs in both forward and backward directions is 'two'.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
